question: Does the component ATtiny45-20P have a maximum voltage of 5V according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: According to the ATtiny45-20P datasheet (http://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/atmel-2586-avr-8-bit-microcontroller-attiny25-attiny45-attiny85_datasheet.pdf), the ATtiny45-20P operates at 2.7V-5.5V, so its maximum voltage is 5.5V, not exactly 5V.
